paragraphs.source_en: O mountain, I do not praise your strength. O sea, I do not sing of your vastness. O winds and waves, I do not celebrate the boundlessness of your power; But for the little grasses and wildflowers struggling in the snow, the voiceless widows in roadside gloom, and the nestlings burned in the desert, yearning to return home,— to them, and to all the nameless misfortunes of the universe, I make my offering: the heat in my chest, the blood within my veins, the light in my spirit; My poem— in a brief, ringing moment of song, the clouds beyond heaven weave joy for you, raise up a rainbow bridge, pointing toward eternal carefree wandering, and in the bright, resounding song, absorb boundless sorrow and grief; Composed in the early spring of 1929.

我拜獻，拜獻我胸脅間的熱，

管裏的血，靈性裏的光明；

paragraphs.source_zh:
山，我不讚美你的壯健，

海，我不歌詠你的闊大，

風波，我不頌揚你威力的無邊；

但那在雪地裏掙扎的小草花，

路旁冥盲中無告的孤寡，

燒死在沙漠裏想歸去的雛燕，──

給他們，給宇宙間一切無名的不幸，

我拜獻，拜獻我胸脅間的熱，

管裏的血，靈性裏的光明；

我的詩歌──在歌聲嘹亮的一俄頃，

天外的雲彩為你們織造快樂，

起一座虹橋，

指點著永恆的逍遙，

在嘹亮的歌聲裏消納了無窮的苦厄！

一九二九年初春作
